channels.name: Wyoming Department of Environmental Quality (harmful cyanobacteria bloom bulletins)
channels.note: WDEQ's public bulletin topic, issued with the Department of Health: each bulletin carries the table of current bloom and toxin advisories (water, location, type, date issued), and a lift has its own bulletin. 25 bulletins from 2026-07-31 to 2026-10-28 on 2026-11-15; read by the wy-deq-hcb-bulletins feed (71 advisories).

channels.name: Wyoming DEQ (past HCB advisories layer)
channels.note: 78 waters with per-year columns of the advisories issued (layer metadata and count read 2026-11-14; last data edit 2025-06-17). Not read for records in this build: channel not researched beyond its metadata. Watched.

channels.name: Wyoming DEQ (harmful cyanobacteria blooms program page)
channels.note: The program page and its FAQ: an advisory holds until the bloom has dissipated or toxins are below the recreational levels, or December 31, whichever comes first.

channels.name: Wyoming DEQ (current HCB advisories StoryMap)
channels.link_text: the current bloom and toxin advisory lists
channels.note: A script page with the current Bloom Advisory, Toxin Advisory and Under Investigation lists; its rows match the bulletins' table, which is read (wy-deq-hcb-bulletins). The Under Investigation list is not in the bulletins and is not read.

channels.name: Wyoming DEQ (news: Hudson wastewater release, June 2024)
channels.note: WDEQ's June 2024 updates on the Hudson wastewater release (expansion research). Not ingested: the pages answered HTTP 500 to the build's client on 2026-11-14; watched so the refresh records when they answer.

channels.name: Wyoming DEQ (spill reporting system)
channels.note: DEQ's spill system publishes a CSV of every spill report it has closed, through the portal's 'Download Report' button: incident date and time, county, town, substance, quantity, whether the spill reached water, the water and a point; 6,066 reports of every substance on 2026-11-16, 84 of them sewage by the feed's rule (the newest 2026-09-23). The portal's incident search still needs a login. Read by the feed wy-deq-spill-list.

channels.name: Wyoming DEQ (Sanitary Sewer Overflows, WYPDES)
channels.legal_basis: WDEQ, Sanitary Sewer Overflows (WYPDES program page): "Reporting of the SSO should occur verbally within 24 hours of becoming aware of the event"; written notification to WDEQ within five days after the event
channels.note: The page that sets the 24-hour verbal and five-day written report; watched for a change.

channels.name: Wyoming DEQ (sanitary sewer overflow reports)
channels.legal_basis: WDEQ, Sanitary Sewer Overflows (WYPDES program page): "Reporting of the SSO should occur verbally within 24 hours of becoming aware of the event"; written notification to WDEQ within five days after the event
channels.note: No web channel found: operators report an overflow to WDEQ by telephone within 24 hours and in writing within five days; WDEQ publishes none of them. An overflow also reported to DEQ's spill line appears on DEQ's public spill list (wy-deq-spills, read by the feed wy-deq-spill-list): 84 sewage reports from February 2010 on 2026-11-16, 18 of them in 2025 and 12 in 2026. A redacted export of the overflow reports is a records request to WDEQ; none has been sent.

channels.name: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (ECHO)
